policy: Only sources whose recording license permits redistribution are eligible for bundled app audio. Speaker age/sex labels are used only when explicitly supported by source metadata.

voiceSets.label: Japanese reference voice
voiceSets.author: Hakatanoshio117117
voiceSets.processing: Detect a voiced kana token, retain a small onset/offset margin, apply pitch-preserving duration adjustment for button usability, active-RMS match, mono 24 kHz PCM, and short fades.

jp_u.note: Language-specific Japanese /u/ sample; app label remains /ɯ/ or [ɯᵝ]-like pedagogical notation.

voiceSets.label: Human IPA reference
voiceSets.author: 173 Ascension 257 (Alex Eduardo Gonzalez)
voiceSets.processing: Detect the 37 isolated utterances in the published sequence, map by sequence index, mono 24 kHz PCM, active-RMS match, add short fades. These are generic IPA reference productions, not General American population norms. KIT /ɪ/ is no longer taken from this set in v0.4.3.

voiceSets.label: US English word reference
voiceSets.license: CC BY-SA 2.5 (dual-licensed with GFDL 1.2+; app uses the CC BY-SA option)
voiceSets.author: Dvortygirl
voiceSets.processing: Manual acoustic boundary selection from the US-English word kid: approximately 0.205–0.315 s, after /k/ aspiration and before /d/ closure. No time-stretch. Mono 24 kHz PCM, 6 ms fade-in, 10 ms fade-out, active-RMS match.

withheldSources.reason: Scientifically valuable and publicly mirrored, but the mirror-level MIT license does not by itself establish redistribution rights for the underlying third-party recordings. Do not bundle until recording rights are clarified.
Research-purpose restrictions are not suitable for unrestricted public-app redistribution.
